{{NPC Infobox|name={{PAGENAME}}|image={{PAGENAME}}.png|location=[[Refugee camp]]|vendor=Graveyard items|money=1000|levelcostIII={{Happiness||100}}|levelcostII={{Happiness||70}}}}

The '''Undertaker''' is part of the [[Game of Crone]] DLC. She arrives at the [[Refugee camp]] after you built and filled the third tent. Her questline will be available the next day.

==Quests==
First, she asks you to make a few new tools ({{Item|Iron chisel|5}}, {{Item|Wood wedge|10}}) for her because she left them in the Town. Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier I. 

Next, she'll ask you to build a [[Undertaker's workplace|workplace]] for her at the [[Refugee camp|camp]]. Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier II. 

To enable her to make better quality gravestones, she asks you to bring {{Item|steel chisel|5|gold}}. Finishing this quest unlocks trading tier III and she'll give you {{Item|Recipe advanced gravestones}}, {{Item|Recipe advanced gravestones II}}.
